newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Reading & Bates estimate upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Reading & Bates estimate upped.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Wednesday it increased its estimate of Reading & Bates Corp's earnings for fiscal 1997 to $2.30 a share from $2.10.

-- Hanifen said the company's earnings of $0.36 in the fourth quarter of 1996, compared to $0.12 a year ago, were slightly better than the consensus estimate of $0.35. The earnings increase was primarily attributable to higher dayrates and improved fleet utilization, Hanifen said.
-- Reading & Bates operates a fleet of 19 oil rigs.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/8 Wednesday at 28.
